title: Deer Isle Endgame Loot Flow
description: Structured, canonical representation of deer-isle-endgame-loot-flow.mmd. Must stay in sync with the .mmd file; see scripts/check-graph-integrity.mjs.

comment.description: Update this file whenever you make changes to the flowchart. Always run `npm run check:integrity` after editing this file.

subgraphs.description: Mermaid subgraphs (locations / crafting trees). Order is for readability only.

label.description: Display text including emoji, e.g. 'Diving Suit 🤿'.

shape.description: Mermaid node shape: rect [ ], stadium ( ), subroutine [/ /], hexagon {{ }}, double-circle [[ ]].

tickable.description: True for quest_loot/endgame_loot/optional_loot; false for place/action/terminal (state is derived).

quantity.description: Maximum useful inventory count for this item; defaults to 1.

subgraphId.description: id of the containing subgraph, or null if top-level.

requires.description: How this node's incoming requirement edges (from the graph's 'main'/'consume'/'travel' edge types) combine: 'all' (default) needs every predecessor done; 'any' needs just one (alternative routes/acquisition methods, e.g. find-or-craft). Not derivable from the .mmd, so scripts/check-graph-integrity.mjs does not validate it.

to.description: Target node id. Edges that point at a subgraph in the .mmd are remapped to that subgraph's representative entry node.

type.description: main: '-->' requirement. consume: '--x' consumed-on-use requirement. travel: '==>' or '===' transport (also a requirement). optional: '-.->' excluded from requirement propagation, distance, and critical-path calculations.

quantity.description: Amount represented by this edge; defaults to 1.
